 RAF Abu Dhabi Results: Khamzat vs. Weidman
 Khamzat Chimaev, Chris Weidman clash in the RAF Abu Dhabi main event
 by Bryan Tucker Nov 14, 2026, 7:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Khamzat Chimaev competes at RAF Abu Dhabi on Saturday. Getty Images Bryan Tucker is the managing editor-in-chief of MMA Fighting and the executive director of combat sports at SB Nation. He has led MMA Fighting since 2009. MMA Fighting has RAF Abu Dhabi results for the Khamzat vs. Weidman match card, live blogs of the top two fights, and more from the Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, UAE, on Saturday afternoon.
 In the main event, former UFC champions Khamzat Chimaev and Chris Weidman square off in a light heavyweight crossover title contest. Chimaev was supposed to face RAF champion Colby Covington for the title, but Covington dropped out of the match.
 Arman Tsarukyan squares off against Neiman Gracie in the co-main event.
 Also on the card, Merab Dvalishvili and Saba Lazishvili compete at the event after their tough week when they were attacked by multiple people in the hotel lobby Wednesday.
 Check out RAF Abu Dhabi results below.
 RAF Abu Dhabi match card (FOX Nation at 12 p.m. ET)

 Arman Tsarukyan vs. Neiman Gracie
